summary: A presentational file upload: drop zone and browse button with client-side pre-checks (type, empty, count; size only when opted in), and the list of files the caller is uploading with per-file state (queued, uploading with progress, uploaded, failed with error text and reference code), download and remove. It sends nothing; an app adapter does the HTTP.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label of the control (translated).

inputs.name: ariaLabelledBy
inputs.description: Id of the caller's own label element, used when there is no label.

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Help text under the label (translated); describes the control.

inputs.name: dropLabel
inputs.description: The prompt inside the drop zone (translated).

inputs.name: browseLabel
inputs.description: The browse button's label (translated).

inputs.name: accept
inputs.description: Extensions, media types and type/* wildcards, comma-separated; empty accepts any type.

inputs.name: maxSizeBytes
inputs.description: OPTIONAL client size pre-check in bytes; null leaves the size to the server, which is authoritative (an oversized file comes back as a failed row with its reference code).

inputs.name: maxFiles
inputs.description: How many files the control holds at most, counting items; more than one allows multi-select.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables browsing, dropping and removing; downloads stay available.

inputs.name: readonly
inputs.description: Shows the list only: no drop zone and no remove buttons; downloads stay.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Marks the control as required (an asterisk; requiredLabel names it for screen readers).

inputs.name: requiredLabel
inputs.description: The screen-reader word for the required marker (translated).

inputs.name: missingText
inputs.description: Shown, and describing the control, while it is required and holds no uploaded file (translated).

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: The current problem (translated), shown as an alert and describing the control.

inputs.name: items
inputs.type: readonly DgaFileUploadItem[] ({ id, name, status: DgaFileUploadStatus (Queued=0, Uploading=1, Uploaded=2, Failed=3), progress?, detail?, errorText?, referenceCode? })
inputs.description: The files the caller holds, with their state, progress (percent, or null for indeterminate), error text and reference code; file-upload-state.ts has the transition helpers.

inputs.name: statusLabels
inputs.description: The announcement per state, templates with {name} (translated), read out through a polite live region.

inputs.name: referenceCodeLabel
inputs.description: The label before a failed row's reference code (translated).

inputs.name: downloadable
inputs.description: Uploaded rows offer a download button (needs downloadLabel).

inputs.name: downloadLabel
inputs.description: The download button's accessible name as a template with {name} (translated).

inputs.name: removeLabel
inputs.description: The remove button's accessible name as a template with {name} (translated); without it rows have no remove button.

outputs.name: filesSelected
outputs.type: DgaFileSelection ({ accepted: File[], rejected: { file, reason: DgaFileRejectionReason (Type=0, Size=1, Empty=2, Count=3) }[] })
outputs.description: Every pick or drop, split by the client-side pre-checks; an empty selection when the dialog was left empty.

outputs.name: download
outputs.description: The uploaded row whose download button was pressed.

outputs.name: remove
outputs.description: The row whose remove button was pressed (never while disabled or read-only).

slots.description: Extra content inside the drop zone, such as the chosen file's name.

a11y: A role=group named by the label (or ariaLabelledBy) and described by the hint, the missing text and the error. The required asterisk is aria-hidden and requiredLabel speaks it. The native file input is hidden from assistive technology and the tab order; the native browse button opens it, so the control is fully keyboard-operable without drag and drop. The file list sits in a polite live region: each row's translated status (statusLabels), error text and reference code are announced as they change. File names are isolated with bdi and reference codes are dir=ltr; progress bars are labelled by their file name; each download and remove button is named for its file. Logical CSS mirrors in RTL.
